visa_intro_1: Ma khadi a ngongole ndi Bitcoin ndi njira zolipirira, koma zimagwira ntchito mosiyana kwambiri.
visa_intro_2: Ma khadi a ngongole monga Visa ndi maukonde otsekeka olamulira ndi mabungwe a ndalama, pomwe Bitcoin ndi ukonde wotseguka womwe aliyense amatha kugwiritsa ntchito.
visa_intro_3: Tiyeni tione kusiyana pakati pa njira ziwiri za malipiro izi: Bitcoin ndi Visa.
point_1_summary_1: Bitcoin ndi netiweki yotseguka yomwe aliyense angathe kulowamo ndi kugwiritsa ntchito popanda chilolezo. Visa ndi dongosolo lotseka lolamulidwa ndi mabungwe a ndalama omwe akhoza kukana mwayi — makamaka kwa anthu omwe alibe akaunti kapena osasamalidwa bwino ndi mabanki.
point_1_summary_2: Izi zimapangitsa Bitcoin kukhala yophatikizira ndi yopezeka kwa anthu padziko lonse.
point_2_summary_1: Kugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin kulibe ndalama za amalonda. Visa nthawi zambiri imalipira amalonda pafupifupi 3% pa kugwiritsa ntchito kulikonse — bizinesi yanu ikhoza kusunga ndalama polandira
point_3_summary_1: Kugwiritsa ntchito kulikonse kwa Bitcoin kuli pa blockchain ya pagulu yomwe imatha kufufuzidwa. Visa imayendetsa dongosolo lotseka komanso lake komwe makasitomala sangathe kutsimikizira kalikonse okha.
point_3_summary_2: Kuonetsa kumeneku kumapangitsa Bitcoin kukhala yodalirika kwambiri.
point_4_summary_1: Bitcoin singatsekedwe ndi ulamuliro wapakatikati uliwonse. Visa ikhoza kutseka akaunti, kuletsa zochita, kapena kukana ntchito nthawi iliyonse.
point_4_summary_2: Ndi Bitcoin, mumasunga ulamuliro wa ndalama zanu ndipo simungathe kuduka pa dongosolo la malipiro.
point_5_summary_1: Bitcoin ndi kutsiriza komaliza — mungathe kugwiritsa ntchito zomwe muli nazo. Makhadi ongongoletsa amapanga ngongole ndi chiwongolero chomwe nthawi zambiri chimaposa 25% pachaka.
point_5_summary_2: Machitidwe a Bitcoin ndi omaliza popanda kupanga ngongole - mutha kugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin yomwe muli nayo yokha.
point_6_summary_3: popanda banki kapena wopanga malipiro ofunika. Makhadi ongongoletsa nthawi zonse amafuna apakati.
point_7_summary_1: Bitcoin imagwira ntchito 24/7 padziko lonse popanda nthawi za bizinesi. Visa ili ndi nthawi zogwirira ntchito, nthawi zokonza, ndi malire amalo omwe akhoza kuletsa zochita.
point_7_summary_2: Maukonde a ma khadi a ngongole ali ndi maola a ntchito, nthawi yokonzakonza, ndi malire a madera omwe amatha kuletsa machitidwe.
hero_title: Kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Visa
